name: Sunil Industries Limited
about: Sunil Industries Limited manufactures and sells textiles in India. The company offers cotton fabrics; flannelette clothes and rolls; polyester/cotton and polyester/viscose blended products; and polyester/viscose dope dyed products. It also provides woolen blended/Angola fabrics; polyester fabrics for curtains and upholstery; polyester mosquito nets and fabrics; synthetic web equipment; camouflage pattern printed on various fabrics; nylon fabrics for parachute; and sarees, dhotis, and lungis, as well as S.D. parachute fabrics. It serves Indian Army, Indian Air Force, Indian Navy, Central Reserve Police Force, Border Security Force, Indian Tibet Border Police, Central Industrial Security Force, State Police, and State Transport clients. Sunil Industries Limited was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Mumbai, India.
